title_en: Close to Petro Nini Luarasi High School, 1+1 Apartment for Sale, Perfect Location!!
description_en: Close to the Petro Nini Luarasi High School, on Bilal Xhaferri street, 1+1 apartment for sale, with a perfect location!!! The apartment is located on the first floor of an existing building. The apartment has a net area of ​​62 m2. The organization of the apartment begins with the corridor that divides the living room together with the dining and cooking area, a bedroom, a balcony and a bathroom with a window. The apartment is completely invested from scratch, starting with new electrical and plumbing installations, parquet, double-glazed plastic windows, internal and external doors. The area offers many facilities starting from the perfect location, the proximity to the Center and the institutions, the proximity to the artificial lake and the large park and for this reason it is a very good opportunity both for living and for investment since the rents are very high in that area. The apartment can also be used for offices. It has full mortgage documentation.
